sourceCopy.name: Fuel Economy Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Fuel Economy Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Measure real fuel economy in L/100 km, km/L or MPG. Log full-to-full refills, track cost per distance and export a CSV.
sourceCopy.intro: Measure what your vehicle actually uses. Add each complete full-to-full refill to compare fuel economy and cost over time.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I calculate fuel economy from a refill?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter the distance driven since the previous full tank, the fuel added at this refill and the total price paid. For a useful result, start and end each interval with a full tank. The calculator converts the same entry to L/100 km, km/L, US MPG and imperial MPG.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does the fuel log leave this page?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Entries stay in this browser tab and are cleared when you clear them or close the page. Export a CSV yourself if you want a separate copy. No account, upload or fuel-price service is used.
howTo: Choose the distance and fuel-volume units used for your receipt or odometer.
Add the distance since the last full tank, fuel added and total amount paid. Use full-to-full intervals for a comparable average.
Review the interval and weighted totals, remove entries if needed, or export the table to CSV.

fields.fullToFull: Log only complete full-to-full intervals for a reliable average.
fields.sessionNote: History stays in this tab only, up to 100 entries. It is not saved automatically. Use one currency for all entries; it stays locked while entries remain.
fields.sourceNote: This is a calculation from your entries, not an official vehicle rating. Odometer readings, pump shut-off, terrain, traffic, weather, load, driving style and fuel type can change real-world results.

messages.invalid: Check the date, distance, fuel and cost, then try again.
messages.exportUnavailable: Your browser could not create the CSV file.
messages.maximum: The log already has 100 refills. Export or clear it before adding more.

additionalFaqs.question: What does L/100 km mean?
additionalFaqs.answer: It is the litres of fuel used to travel 100 kilometres. A lower number means less fuel for the same distance.

additionalFaqs.question: How do I convert fuel economy to US MPG?
additionalFaqs.answer: Choose the distance and fuel units for your entry. The calculator converts the same measured interval to US MPG and imperial MPG; those gallon sizes are different.

additionalFaqs.question: Why should I use full-to-full refills?
additionalFaqs.answer: Starting and ending with a full tank makes the fuel added a closer measure of what was used over that distance. One partial refill can make an interval less accurate.
